brief_source: brief section 5.5, the composition table, rows 1 to 5, and the five composition laws; brief section 5.8.1, the composition property fixtures, tested under AC-P12

expected.field_12_carries: no rollup word, and the words form statement naming the open case
expected.composition_table_row: Row 1, open case: where the run meets an open case under section 5.4.2, contract field 12 carries no rollup word and carries the words form statement naming the open case.
Row 2, proven failure: where any composing check takes FAIL, contract field 12 carries FAIL, composed under the D16 order.

Row 3, Plaid bound: where no composing check takes FAIL and a Plaid claim stands, contract field 12 carries UNVERIFIABLE, and no PASS rollup stands on a Plaid claim. Case two: where no composing check takes UNVERIFIABLE, the word stands as the bound outcome at item 15 only and not by composition.

Row 4, composed word: otherwise, where no earlier row matches, contract field 12 carries the first word in the order FAIL, then UNVERIFIABLE, then NOT PROVEN, then PASS, that any composing check takes.
Row 5, all pass: PASS stands only where every composing check is PASS.

expected.relation: the same rollup in both runs
expected.brief_fixture: A listing order property fixture: the same composing set of checks presented in two listing orders in two runs, expected at the same rollup in both runs, tested under AC-P12.

expected.relation: the same rollup in both runs, as the rollup of the whole set
expected.brief_fixture: A grouping property fixture: the same composing set of checks presented grouped by team in one run and not grouped in another run, expected at the same rollup in both runs, as the rollup of the whole set, tested under AC-P12.

expected.relation: the same rollup in both runs
expected.brief_fixture: A PASS identity property fixture: the same composing set of checks in two runs, the second run adding a composing PASS check to that set, expected at the same rollup in both runs, tested under AC-P12.

expected.relation: the rollup in the second run never improves on the rollup in the first run, the one composing word standing weakened along the D16 order, from PASS toward FAIL
expected.brief_fixture: A monotonicity property fixture: two runs on the same composing set, in which one composing word in the second run stands weakened along the D16 order, from PASS toward FAIL, against the first run, expected at a rollup in the second run that never improves on the rollup in the first run, tested under AC-P12.

expected.relation: the same rollup in both runs, a word from a check marked non composing never entering the operation, and the varied word not being the Plaid bound outcome acting through row 3
expected.brief_fixture: An isolation property fixture: two runs on the same composing set, in which a word from a check marked non composing varies between the first run and the second run, and that word is not the Plaid bound outcome acting through row 3, expected at the same rollup in both runs, tested under AC-P12.
